explication: SchemaStore is a public catalog of JSON Schemas. The main user workflow is to browse or search the website catalog, select a schema, and retrieve it; contributors also use the CLI to validate schemas and check catalog consistency. The CLI imports coverage analysis, while the website loads catalog data for display. The README documents a separately hosted MCP server for searching, browsing, and retrieving schemas; its implementation is not in this repository. The graph reflects the shown source and documentation, not unsampled internals.
